skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 90% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Grants an ally [Berserk] state for 1 turn(s) and increases their SPD by 20%.[Berserk]: Increases DMG dealt by 30% when attacking.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Grants an ally [Berserk] state for 1 turn(s) and increases their SPD by 30%.[Berserk]: Increases DMG dealt by 35% when attacking.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP. The first time taking fatal DMG each battle, revives with HP equal to 5% of self max HP.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP. The first time taking fatal DMG each battle, revives with HP equal to 10% of self max HP.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases self max HP. The first time taking fatal DMG each battle, revives with HP equal to 13% of self max HP.
